reviews.title: It Asks for Your ZIP Code
reviews.text:
Upon signing up, the app asks for your ZIP code, stating that it’s needed in case you need to contact local support. 

I understand the reasoning behind this, but I wasn’t able to continue without providing it. I don’t think it should be required, as it feels like an unnecessary intrusion into users’ privacy. 

The only way I was able to get past this screen was by signing out, signing back in with my Apple ID, and completing the set up. Fortunately, it automatically skipped the ZIP code page the second time and I was able to access the app. 

Please consider making the ZIP code optional rather than mandatory. 

Other than that, I have no complaints and look forward to using the app!

reviews.title: Great all
reviews.text: I’m not really the kind of person that leaves app reviews. But this app is worthy of praising, my wife showed it to me because I’ve been have a rough time mentally lately. And it’s genuinely been so helpful for getting all my thoughts out, with its prompts. It’s genuinely helpful. And there aren’t and subscriptions or ads, which is so important for trying to ground yourself and escape from reality, the app doesn’t have any expectations that make you feel like you’re a consumer before you’re a human being, which is greatly appreciated. A huge thank you to the developers of this app!

reviews.title: This is the BEST Journal ever
reviews.text: I have been using Mirror for a few weeks know and it helped me improve my mental health so much!!! It has made me better at expressing my emotions to my family. It is the best way to vent. I can take a video or an audio recording or even type it out. I also love the prompts they give you. But my favorite thing is the over view where AI gives you a summary of each days entry so you can know what and why you where angry on that day. Overall the best journaling app ever 100% recommend

reviews.title: Can’t import or export entries
reviews.text: I have this app on two devices, it asks you to login so I assumed you could sync or import from the app if on two devices but you cannot. You have to keep them separately, a bit annoying. Mirror app is a good concept but lacks a lot. The entries can be confusing, after writing an entry you think you’re done but yet another frame pops up asking how you feel about the entry. Ease of use to myself is not comfortable. The interface is a bit drab looking. I give the app 2 stars and will pass.

reviews.title: Great App with Room for Improvement

Second, it would be useful to go back to finished journals to edit or add anything. Despite this, I still think it’s a great app overall!

reviews.title: It is hard not to look back
reviews.text: Downloaded the app a week or so ago - it is hard not to look back at the AI summaries! They really are helpful for reflection. I also love the mood tracking - turns out I usually feel better after journaling. Overall, this is a fun and insightful app to use. Recommend.

reviews.title: Guided journaling experience opens you up
reviews.text: A friend pushed me to try this. I don’t have any experience journaling, so I was not sure what to expect. The guided journaling is very cool…the prompts basically get you going, open you up. Once I got the hang of it, journaling is really easy and a bit addictive (turns out I like making unguided entries now too) - especially looking back at the summaries you get back. I hope they keep adding new guides to this.

reviews.title: love the AI summary
reviews.text: I am not a big time journaler, but once i got going, i was amazed how much i had to say. the AI summary is an exciting part of this app. took a few minutes to figure out the app, but once i got going, really easy.

reviews.title: Mirror is such a great journaling app!
reviews.text: I love the mood check feature, and the prompts are super easy to follow. It’s been a great resource for checking in with myself!

reviews.title: Helpful for Managing Anxiety & Reflection
reviews.text: Mirror has been a huge help in managing my anxiety. Knowing it’s developed by experts makes me trust the guided prompts and mood tracking, which have been incredibly supportive. It’s a private, safe space where I can reflect, process my thoughts, and better understand my emotions. It’s made mindfulness a regular part of my life and helped me feel more in control.

reviews.title: Best Journaling App So Far!
reviews.text: This app deserves a review! This is a fantastic app for self-reflection, offering video and audio journaling for a more personal touch. The mood check-ins help track emotional patterns, and the intuitive prompts make journaling so easy and meaningful. They also have a focus on privacy and customization which I love!! It’s a safe space for growth. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great guided journaling
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful app, and I love the guided prompts to help me think of what to write (or speak! My favorite way to draft entries is with voice memos.) The mood tracker is great for helping me put words to how I’m feeling in the moment. If you click on your entry, there is a bullet point summary generated by an LLM, which is really helpful for me when I write long rambling entries - it shows me a simpler version of what I was trying to say.
